title: cyclopogon elatus
intro: Cyclopogon elatus, commonly known as the "Golden Lilyturf", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asphodelaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclopogon elatus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
